abstract.t: This document defines the canonical object format for the Secured Digital Lifecycle Protocol (SDLP). The object format specifies the normative byte-level representation used for hashing, signing, validation, and interoperability across SDLP implementations. All SDLP-governed objects MUST follow the canonical encoding, field ordering, and serialization grammar defined in this specification. This document updates and replaces draft-norton-sdlp-obj-format-01 and resolves inconsistencies identified during interoperability analysis with Identity-02 and Lifecycle-02.
